## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, exceptionally good-looking youth of attractive appearance, noted for being terribly handsome with broad shoulders. He has wavy chestnut hair and an open-faced expression often marked by a mocking grin. His bright, direct eyes have been described as hazel, mischievous light-brown, and filled with a mixture of diffidence and enthusiasm.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Personality

Hugh is a tall, intelligent youth with wavy chestnut hair and a mischievous, teasing demeanor toward girls. Driven by unique personal perspectives, he aims to get the most out of life while contributing his absolute best. Practical and self-reliant, he is motivated to cover his own college expenses due to his father's inability to pay for his education.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## History

During his childhood, Hugh Carrow spent three years living in Alberta after his father fell ill, and later spent a summer visiting his cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). At [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school, he frequently teased [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), once pulling her hair until she smashed her slate over his head. Though he later rescued [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a dory when her boat sank during a reenactment, she stubbornly rejected his offer of friendship. Later, while attending Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), Hugh silently competed with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md); he ultimately won the Medal while she secured the [Avery](../codex/places.md#avery) scholarship. Upon graduating, Hugh voluntarily withdrew his application for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) teaching position so [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could take the role to support her aunt, leading to a reconciliation where the two former foes became close friends. Hugh went on to teach at [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel), returning home on weekends and discussing classroom discipline and their experiences with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). He frequently visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), sharing local news, recounting the impact of a severe storm on his school, and conversing with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by the Nymph's Well. While walking [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to his buggy after [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) Penrose's wedding, Hugh's gentle words triggered a sudden awakening in [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), shifting her perception of their companionship as she realized her deeper feelings for him.

## Quotes

> "Nell, my actions were not especially noble. Being of slight assistance to you brought me pleasure. Will friendship exist between us from now on? Is my former misdeed truly pardoned by you?"
>
> — Hugh Carrow — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "Elias Purdy returned from Regent’s today to spend Sunday, and he was supposed to carry out a book that Professor Garrick is loaning to me."
>
> — Hugh Carrow — [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P19](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0019)

> "I am never going to ask for your friendship again, Nell Harcourt. Nor do I even care!"
>
> — Hugh Carrow — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "yet would it not have been even finer, Nell, had no rift or misapprehension ever occurred . . . had they traveled side by side through their entire existence, possessing no recollections from the past except the ones they shared together?"
>
> — Hugh Carrow — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0039)

> "Mr. Pidgeon, the blame belongs to me because I provoked her."
>
> — Hugh Carrow — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/hugh-carrow--nell-harcourt.md)

Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) started as hostile classmates when he mocked her hair and pulled it, prompting her to smash a slate over his head and refuse to speak to or forgive him. Their relationship evolved into a silent academic rivalry at school, though Hugh harbors romantic feelings for her, keeping a dropped rose and later rescuing her in his dory when her boat sank. Over time, their animosity faded, and they eventually became good friends and fellow members of the B.V.I.S., though there is a presumed claim that they are married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), +29 more_
